title: Gimbal radar returns as interference or echoes of a distant jet
summary: Mick West tells of Gimbal radar returns as interference or echoes of a distant jet, about 2015 at Off the US East Coast (Roosevelt, 2014 to 2015), and relays what a named person told them. As told, not a fact.

tellings.quote: Perhaps there was a distant jet and the the radar got messed up and it made it appear as you someone actually told me that as a possibility.

plain: Mick West, a UFO skeptic, discussed on Jesse Michels' podcast the radar readings that Navy aircrew describe around the Gimbal video, a 2015 recording off the US East Coast of an object that seems to turn. West says someone suggested to him that there may have been a distant jet and the radar got confused, making false returns or echoes, which would mean the strange radar picture came from the equipment, not from an unknown craft.
